text:
elena: Heads-up — planning a relaunch of the weekly newsletter next Tue. Goal: better onboarding drip for new signups + a short benchmark narrative in each issue. Draft timeline and cohorts below. :spiral_calendar:

sam: Nice. Proposal: split into 3 cohorts (new, active trial, dormant). Run subject-line A/B and 9am vs 3pm send for EMEA. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

maria: I wrote two subject variants + 1 preview. Copy snippets pasted here: 

Subject A: 'How teams cut inference costs by 3x — new benchmarks inside'
Subject B: 'Real LLM savings: benchmarks + playbook (2 min read)'
Preview: 'Quick wins for latency and cost — test them in your stack.'

kevin: UI ask — can we reuse the product micrographic from last launch? If yes I'll adapt colors for the newsletter header.

noah: tagging the analytics plan: we'll track open rate, CTR to benchmark page, and a funnel metric for signup->trial. Suggest using cohort_id in UTM: ?utm_cohort=weekX_cohortY

elena: @kevin yes, please reuse and adjust. @maria great start — can you add an alternate that leans less technical for our SMB list?

maria: Yep — added lighter copy below. Also dropped segmentation SQL for the cohorts for ops: 
```sql
-- cohort selection (pseudo)
SELECT user_id, email FROM users WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND (last_active >= NOW()-INTERVAL '30 days') AS active_cohort;
```

sam: Ops ask: can we get the send window & timezone mapping? EMEA gets 9am/3pm tests, NA stays at 10am PT. Also, prioritize the trial cohort for the first send.

elena: Plan for rollout: 
- Mon: final copy + assets by noon
- Tue AM: dry run to internal list (team + 50 beta)
- Tue 10am PT: send to trial cohort
- Tue 3pm PT & Wed: other cohorts + A/B analysis starts 24h after send.

kevin: I uploaded hero and two variants here: https://drive.google.com/example-link — I added alt text and sizes.

maria: Quick note on CTAs: primary -> Benchmark article, secondary -> 'Try Redwood' with 10% credit. Is legal ok with promo? @elena

elena: Legal gave a thumbs-up yesterday for a time-limited credit. Include expiry copy.

noah: I'll wire up analytics and the cohort tags. Expect dashboards to populate within 6 hours post-send.

sam: Small experiment idea: add a 1-question micro survey at bottom for the dormant cohort to surface friction signal. Keep it one click.

elena: Love it. Maria to add. Kevin to provide a small button treatment for the micro-survey.

jira-bot: Issue INF-482 created: 'Newsletter relaunch — send config + cohort mapping' assigned to sam, noah, maria.

elena: OK folks, finalize by EOD Monday. Any blockers? :rocket:
